title: E8: verify Dolt-gated checkpoint suite green on a dolt-equipped host
description: Epic loreweaver-7wc acceptance #1-#4 (checkpoint creates a dolt commit + list; restore round-trip-identical; fork isolated branch+copy) are covered by describe.skipIf(!DoltRepo.available()) suites. They were SKIPPED during E8 implementation because the dev host had no 'dolt' binary. Logic + offline acceptance (#5 fs guard, serializer determinism) are proven. ACTION: on a host with the dolt CLI installed, run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/checkpoint.doltRepo.test.ts packages/core/test/checkpoint.store.test.ts packages/core/test/checkpoint.restore.test.ts packages/core/test/checkpoint.fork.test.ts and confirm the gated specs PASS (not skip). Then epic loreweaver-7wc can close. If any fail, file bugs and reopen the relevant child task.
close_reason: Verified on a dolt-equipped host (this machine, via 'loreweaver dolt install' -> dolt v2.0.3). All 4 Dolt-gated suites run (not skip) and PASS: doltRepo, store, restore (round-trip identical), fork (isolated). Full suite 56 passed/1 skipped, typecheck 0. Live verification also caught & fixed 4 real defects (dolt-init identity, ANSI hash corruption, zip extraction, fork-test assertion) — committed dbdfa9b. Epic acceptance #1-#4 now genuinely satisfied.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Resolver landed (loreweaver-a15): the Dolt-gated suite now also runs if you set LOREWEAVER_DOLT_BIN=/path/to/dolt — no need for dolt on PATH. Verification recipe: install/point at dolt, set that env var, run the four gated checkpoint suites; confirm PASS not skip.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: To get a dolt for this verification you can now run 'loreweaver dolt install' (managed, sha256-verified, opt-in) instead of a manual install; resolveDoltBinary then finds it automatically.
